exposure: Presence or absence of maternal chorioamnionitis
cohort: 117 mothers and their extremely premature babies (born before 28 weeks' gestation)
finding: Neonatal thyroid status in extremely preterm infants is independently affected by gestation and not by maternal factors such as route of delivery, exogenous maternal glucocorticoid administration, third trimester maternal FT4, presence or absence of chorioamnionitis, smoking status, BMI, TPO status or haemoglobin levels.
